gloss: light snowfall; fine snow; gently falling snow

definitions.gloss: light snowfall; fine snow; gently falling snow
definitions.explanation: Delicate, fine snow falling gently. A poetic and literary word evoking a quiet, beautiful winter scene.

examples.japanese: {細雪|ささめゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}っている→舞う：04573_mau⟧。
examples.english: Fine snow is dancing in the air.
Outside the window, fine snow was falling quietly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{細雪|ささめゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り→降る：00839_furu⟧{始|はじ}め、⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一変|いっぺん}→一変：11203_ippen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Fine snow began to fall on the town at dusk, transforming the scenery.

notes:
A literary and poetic word for delicate, gently falling snow. Composed of {細|ささめ} (fine, delicate) + ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧ (snow). Evokes a quiet, elegant winter atmosphere and is associated with refined, literary Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {細雪|ささめゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧: fine snow dances in the air
- {細雪|ささめゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧: fine snow falls
- {細雪|ささめゆき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: amid the gently falling snow

LITERARY NOTE:
The most famous use of this word is as the title of {谷崎潤一郎|たにざきじゅんいちろう}'s novel {細雪|ささめゆき} (The Makioka Sisters, 1943-1948), a masterwork of modern Japanese literature depicting the lives of four sisters in a wealthy Osaka family. The title evokes the beauty and transience of their fading world.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{粉雪|こなゆき}→粉雪：13858_konayuki⟧: powder snow — light, dry snow; less literary than {細雪|ささめゆき}
- ⟦{新雪|しんせつ}→新雪：22448_shinsetsu⟧: fresh snow — emphasizes newness rather than delicacy
- {小雪|こゆき}: light snow — a more neutral term for light snowfall; also the name of a seasonal division in the traditional calendar
